summary_of_cross_package_alignment_decis: All packages use WP-0200 staged vocabulary where available: inspect, refresh, export, draft/proposal, copy_command, local_marker, request; safe_read_only, safe_local_generated_artifact_update, steward_confirmed_local_mutation, authority_gated_institutional_action.
All staged controls are local-only, fail closed, and preserve no-upload guarantees.
Drafts, promotions, requests, and approvals are explicitly non-executing until a later authority route/install-handoff accepts them.
